subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should this v1 schema, privacy policy, identity model, and create-only filesystem design become ClawSweeper’s durable source-of-truth contract?
rationale: The patch defines persistent security-sensitive interfaces that downstream workflow writers and future replay, retention, and migration tools will depend on; implementation correctness cannot decide the intended long-term compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve with integrated validation
options.body: Review this foundation with https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 and merge in dependency order after validating real success, interruption, partial, and failure paths alongside legacy behavior.

options.title: Keep v1 experimental
options.body: Retain draft status or narrow the initially promised schema, privacy, retention, and replay guarantees until lifecycle and upgrade policy is settled.

options.title: Pause the ledger program
options.body: Do not freeze a durable source-of-truth contract until maintainers decide that immutable action history is worth its ongoing compatibility and security obligations.

recommendation.title: Approve with integrated validation
recommendation.body: Review this foundation with https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/512 and merge in dependency order after validating real success, interruption, partial, and failure paths alongside legacy behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The adjacent current-main history and existing completed review identify him as the strongest available product-level owner for a permanent automation and storage contract.
